Theorem 3
nodes.statement:
Let $a,b,c\geq0$, $r,s\in[-1,1]$, and $\tau\in\mathcal{S}_0^{3}$.
	Then
	\begin{equation}
			\tau(a) - \tau(c) - \tau_{\!\sqrt{}}\!\left( a^2-2rab+b^2 \right) + \tau_{\!\sqrt{}}\!\left( c^2-2scb+b^2 \right)
			\leq 
			2 b \tau^\prime\!\left( \max(ra - sc, |a-c|) \right)
		\, .
	\end{equation}

Lemma 14: i $c\geq a\geq b \geq sc$
nodes.statement:
Let $\tau\in\mathcal{S}_0^{3}$.
	Let $a,b,c\geq0$, $s\in[-1,1]$.
	Assume $(s+1)c\leq 2a$, $c \geq a \geq b \geq sc$.
	Then
	\begin{equation*}
		\tau(a)-\tau(c)-\tau(a-b)+\tau_{\!\sqrt{}}(c^2-2scb+b^2) 
		\leq
		2 b \tau^\prime(a - sc) 
		\, .
	\end{equation*}

nodes.name: Lemma 15: i $c\geq a\geq b \leq sc$
nodes.statement:
Let $\tau\in\mathcal{S}_0^{3}$.
	Let $a,b,c\geq0$, $s\in[-1,1]$.
	Assume $a\leq c$, $(s+1)c\leq 2a$, $a\geq b$, and $b\leq sc$.
	Then
	\begin{equation*}
		\tau(a)-\tau(c)-\tau(a-b)+\tau_{\!\sqrt{}}(c^2-2scb+b^2) 
		\leq
		2 b \tau^\prime(a - sc) 
		\, .
	\end{equation*}

nodes.name: Lemma 17: i $c\geq a\leq b$
nodes.statement:
Let $\tau\in\mathcal{S}_0^{3}$.
	Let $a,b,c\geq0$, $s\in[-1,1]$.
	Assume $(s+1)c\leq 2a$, $c \geq a$, $a \leq b$.
	Then
	\begin{equation*}
		\tau(a)-\tau(c)-\tau(a-b)+\tau_{\!\sqrt{}}(c^2-2scb+b^2) 
		\leq
		2 b \tau^\prime(a - sc) 
		\, .
	\end{equation*}

nodes.name: Lemma 18: i $a\geq c$ $b\geq 2sc$
nodes.statement:
Let $\tau\in\mathcal{S}_0^{3}$.
	Let $a,b,c\in[0, \infty)$, $s\in[-1,1]$.
	Assume $\frac12 b \leq sc$, $sc \geq a-b$, and $a\geq c$.
	Then
	\begin{equation}
		\tau(a) - \tau(c) - \tau(a-b) + \tau_{\!\sqrt{}}(c^2 - 2 s c b + b^2) 
		\leq 
		2 b \tau^\prime\!\left( \frac{a-sc}{2} \right)
		\, .
	\end{equation}

nodes.name: Lemma 19: i $a\geq c$ $b\leq 2sc$ $sc \leq a-b$
nodes.statement:
Let $\tau\in\mathcal{S}_0^{3}$.
	Let $a,b,c[0, \infty)$, $s\in[-1,1]$. Assume $b \geq 2sc$, $a\geq sc$.
	Then
	\begin{align*}
		\tau(a) - \tau(c) - \tau(\left| a-b \right|) + \tau(c^2 - 2 s c b + b^2)
		\leq 
		2 \tau^\prime\!\left( \frac{a - s c}2 \right)
		\, .
	\end{align*}

nodes.name: Lemma 20: i $c\leq a$ $b\leq 2sc$ $sc\geq a-b$
nodes.statement:
Let $\tau\in\mathcal{S}_0^{3}$.
	Let $a,b,c\in[0, \infty)$, $s\in[-1,1]$.
	Assume $\frac12 b \leq sc\leq a-b$.
	Then
	\begin{equation*}
		\tau(a) - \tau(c) - \tau(a-b) + \tau_{\!\sqrt{}}(c^2 - 2 s c b + b^2) \leq 2 b \tau^\prime\!\left( \frac{a - s c}2 \right)
		\, .
	\end{equation*}
